sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2024
sources.text: While underway, six perpetrators armed with knives entered the engine room through the steering gear door, tied up two crew (oilers) in the engine room workshop and stole the engine spares. An engineer discovered the tied-up crew and informed the master. The master raised alarm and crew mustered. Search was conducted with no further sighting of the perpetrators. The master reported the incident through his agent to Singapore Port Operations Control Centre (POCC) via email.
